title: Private Shore Excursion from Malaga port to Alhambra and Granada.
text: Was pretty much a full day trip from port.  Long ride there and back to the ship. Was interesting in how they engineered an aqueduct to bring water that irrigated all the gardens and to the palace.
author: David_D

title: Beautiful day in Alhambra
text:
This was an amazing experience and our guide, Debbie, was so well organized and knowledgeable.  Once we arrived at the cruise port pier from our ship, she was waiting to take us in a nice air-conditioned bus for the approximate 2-hour trip to Granada.  We did have a bathroom break mid-way on our to and from trips there.
   Alhambra was amazing and we were with Daniel, who was very knowledgeable and charismatic but spoke a little too fast at times.  He took us to the highlights of the gardens and palaces.  Considerable walking, stairs and hills is required.  It was amazing!

author: John_H

title: Alhambra great
text: Good all round. Good rep on bus then transferred to small group with local guide to tour around Alhambra site. Would be a mistake to try and do on your own.
author: Barbara_W

title: Alhambra = Wow!
text:
Excellent experience to visit an amazing site!  We were worried about the timing of such a long trip & the timing to return to the cruise ship.  No problem at all!  The one small hiccup we had was looking for the agent holding the Viator sign on the dock. The agent was holding the sign of the organizing company, not Viator. 
There is a good deal of walking on uneven ground so wearing comfortable walking shoes is a must. Bringing water is also helpful. 
Both our bus and Alhambra guides were very knowledgeable & approachable. Great experience!
author: Shelley_A

title: Truly amazing!
text:
This is a wonderful excursion to a must-see place in Spain that every cruiser should find the time to visit. And with our ship docked in Malaga this was the perfect opportunity to sign up for this amazing trip.

Everything was superbly organised and on time, many thanks to everyone who worked hard to make it happen. We are 100% satisfied and can wholeheartedly recommend this excursion to all cruisers looking for a memorable journey to one of the most interesting landmarks in the entire country.
author: Grazyna_B

title: Alhambra excursion
text: Very informative.  Guides were wonderful!  The bus was also clean and comfortable.  We have no complaints.
author: DIANNA_M

title: Very pleased
text: Everything went according to the schedule and we were very pleased with the quality of our guides. Highly recommend this tour.
author: Galina_K

title: Great tour. Some customers no so much.
text: Very nice tour. Great Tour guide. However, people with mobility issues should not do this tour. Although this is stated before reserving the tour, we had 7-8 people who could not walk without very frequent stops. They eventually had to leave the tour as they felt they could not walk further. It did slow down the rest of the group.
author: Paula_S

title: Excellent tour guide on...
text: Excellent tour guide on the way to Grenada and while there. Place is worth visiting and time well organized for cruise passengers.
author: M_M

title: Pick up and drop off to...
text: Pick up and drop off to the port is really on time.. our guide is very knowledgeable..Beautiful Alhambra but lots of walking .
